dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is monitoring blogs and RSS/Atom feeds, and the artifact only describes blogwatcher commands for adding feeds, scanning, listing articles, marking read status, and removing feeds.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are limited to user-directed CLI usage. Network access to user-specified blog or feed URLs is expected for this purpose.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Installation is transparent and uses `go install github.com/Hyaxia/blogwatcher/cmd/blogwatcher@latest`; `@latest` means the exact upstream code installed can change over time.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The artifact does not request credentials, session stores, environment secrets, broad local indexing, or unrelated filesystem access.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The CLI likely stores tracked blogs, articles, and read status locally, which is proportionate for a feed watcher. The skill does not define background execution, elevated privileges, or autonomous persistence.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege
